name: cold-email-outreach
description:
Writes cold email sequences (initial email plus 2 follow-ups) with
personalization frameworks, value-first subject lines, and clear CTAs for
sales prospecting and business development. Use when the user needs outbound
email sequences, sales outreach templates, or cold prospecting messages. Do
NOT use for professional workplace emails (use `professional-email`), newsletters
(use `newsletter-writing`), or investor updates (use `investor-update-email`).
